task: I need to get our new 'Summer Campaign Launch' project set up in Wrike. I'll create the main project, then add three key tasks: 'Creative Brief Development', 'Ad Copywriting', and 'Media Buying'. I'll assign them to team members, set deadlines, and then use custom fields to track their status and priority. Finally, I'll generate a quick report to see our progress and reassign a task if needed.

observations.what: Submitting the issued email (a '+' alias on gmail.com) in the header 'Try Wrike for free' email box showed a red 'No internet connection' tooltip and did nothing, even though the page itself was fully loaded.

The dedicated 'Start your free two-week trial' form rejected the same email with the same misleading 'No internet connection' error, so sign-up was blocked after two attempts (likely the '+' alias or the non-business gmail domain, but the message does not say so).
Before sign-up the page stacked a cookie consent banner, a 'Join us in New York' event popup and an AI video chat assistant widget, which covered the hero sign-up button.
